caseNameFull: Knebel, Secretary of Agriculture v. Hein and Burns, Commissioner, Department of Social Services of Iowa v. Hein

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. S. D. Iowa., [Probable jurisdiction noted, 426 U. S. 904.] Motion of appellants for divided argument granted. Motion of the Solicitor General to permit Stephen L. Urbanczyk, Esquire, to argue pro hac vice on behalf of appellant in No. 75-1261 granted.
